_about: FC 27 player-capture (miniface from the 3D model) entry points. Game build 1.0.140.64835, memory image C:/FC 27 Live Editor/turbo_output/fc27_image.bin dumped 2026-10-03, image base 0x140000000. Every signature was checked to match exactly once in that image (scripts/re/sig.py). rip-relative disp32 and rel32 branch targets are masked (??). See docs/re/player_capture.md for what each function does and the confidence of its role.

functions.name: PlayerCaptureController_GetOrCreate
functions.role: returns the PlayerCaptureController singleton (looks it up by name 'playerCaptureController', else allocates 0x138 bytes from the FETemp arena, constructs and registers it)

functions.name: PlayerCaptureController_ctor
functions.role: PlayerCaptureController::PlayerCaptureController(this, arena) - zeroes 0x138 bytes, sets the delegate invokers and the two listener vtables

functions.name: PlayerCaptureController_FindExisting
functions.role: named-object lookup used by GetOrCreate (returns the controller or null)

functions.name: PlayerCapture_RequestStatic_A
functions.role: static entry: (unused rcx, const eastl::string* name, const vector<PlayerDesc0x6c>* players, const void* params0x20, [rsp+0x28] Delegate* onDone, [rsp+0x30] int mode, [rsp+0x38] int extra) -> GetOrCreate() then Request_A

functions.name: PlayerCapture_RequestStatic_B
functions.role: static entry (second overload): (unused, rdx, r8 players, r9 Delegate* src, [rsp+0x28] int mode, [rsp+0x30] int extra) -> GetOrCreate() then Request_B

functions.name: PlayerCaptureController_Request_A
functions.role: member: copies name -> +0xA8, params -> +0x48, onDone delegate -> +0x68, mode -> +0x40, extra -> +0x44, resets +0x88, then Start(this, players)

functions.name: PlayerCaptureController_Request_B
functions.role: member (second overload): delegate copies, mode/extra, then Start(this, players)

functions.name: PlayerCaptureController_Start
functions.role: Start(this, const vector<PlayerDesc0x6c>* players): gated on settings byte +0x1F6; copies up to 6 players to +0x20; allocates the 'PlayerCapture' staging buffer (0x11D300 or 0x11E1A30 bytes by mode +0x40); registers the two listeners at +0xC0/+0xF8; builds a 0x448 CaptureRequest and submits it

functions.name: CaptureRequest_Build
functions.role: CaptureRequest* Build(CaptureRequest* out0x448, int type, const vector<PlayerDesc0x6c>* players, int mode, [rsp+0x28] int extra): out+0=type, +4 players[10], +0x43C count, +0x440 mode, +0x444 extra

functions.name: CaptureRenderer_Submit
functions.role: Submit(global [0x14C267B98], CaptureRequest*) - hands the request to the capture renderer

functions.name: UIImages_ReleasePlayerCaptures
functions.role: for each name in vector<string>: path = 'data/ui/imgAssets/playerCapture/p%s.png'; if registry has it, release it (the UI image registry is where a capture ends up)

functions.name: UIImages_ReleaseHeads
functions.role: same for 'data/ui/imgAssets/heads/p%d.png' with int player ids (the regular minifaces share that registry)

functions.name: FE_MessageIdHash_djb2xor
functions.role: uint32 Hash(const char* s, uint32 seed): h = (h*33) ^ c; FE message ids are Hash(name, 0x1505)

functions.name: FE_FIFA_MessageRegistration
functions.role: registers the FE::FIFA::* message handlers (PlayerCaptureRequest id -> this+0x568, PlayerCaptureInit -> +0x5E0, DynTifo* -> +0x658/+0x6D0); the handler factories live in the protected region and were not followed

functions.name: CaptureSlot_Enqueue
functions.role: copies a 0x78 PlayerDesc into one of two slots at owner+0x1188 and tail-calls PlayerDesc_FillFromPlayerData (owner+0x1300==1) or 0x1470DB220

functions.name: PlayerDesc_FillFromPlayerData
functions.role: fills the 0x78 appearance descriptor (+0x20..+0x70: ids, kit, body, hair, skin...) from a loaded player-data object

functions.name: YouthPortraitCaptureExecutor
functions.role: YouthPlayerManager::PortraitCaptureExecutor::Run - marks the youth player (trait 0x704DF) and schedules the 'Special Youth Player Image Capture' job (16 KB stack) with a completion delegate

functions.name: PlayerCaptureStream_OnSlot
functions.role: OnSlot(this, int slot, size_t size): data = buffer + slot * (mode==1 ? 0x2FAF08 : 0x2F880); registry name set -> wrap as 'PlayerCaptureStream' and register under names[(batch-1)*6+slot]; empty name -> onSlot.invoker(players[idx].id, data, size, &onSlot). Hooked by Turbo (pc_slot) to log the game's own pictures

functions.name: PlayerCaptureController_OnSlotEvent
functions.role: listener-1 event handler (event 0xB1FEE06D, payload {0, size, slot}): OnSlot(this, slot, size); counts pictures; all done -> state 4 + Finish; 6 done -> next batch

functions.name: PlayerCaptureController_Complete
functions.role: listener-2 path (event 0x694CE8B7 'rendered'): state 3, sends 6 copy messages (type 0xBAD03A44, payload {buffer + slot*sliceSize, sliceSize, 0})

functions.name: PlayerCaptureController_Finish
functions.role: state 0, message 0xC0DB457A {0,3}, unregister both listeners, free the staging buffer, invoke the done callback (+0x68) when it has a manager

functions.name: CmAvatar_ManagerPortraitCapture
functions.role: career avatar manager-head capture (registry cmAvatarPlayerHeadsVdd / heads_staff): builds the 0x6C PlayerDesc on the stack (id, -1, [this+0x4C], -1, -1, ..., see docs) and calls the FE image service vtable+0x48 (RequestStatic_B) with mode 0, extra 0

functions.name: ProCard_PlayerCapture
functions.role: pro / clubs card capture: PlayerDesc id 0x7AA7, second id from a service, +0x64 = 1, RequestStatic_B through the FE image service vtable+0x48, mode 0, extra 0

functions.name: AvatarOutfitCaptures
functions.role: avatar outfit pictures (registry avatarPlayerCapturesVdd, names '%d_%d' id_outfit): entries {PlayerDesc, int outfit, int flag} stride 0x74; RequestStatic_A through vtable+0x28 with mode 1, extra 3 (or '%d' names with extra 0)

function_shape.eastl_function: {storage[16]; void* (*manager)(void* to, void* from, int op /*0 destruct, 1 copy, 2 move*/); R (*invoker)(Args..., const void* storage)}
function_shape.onSlot: void(int id, void* data, size_t size, const void* storage)

globals.name: CaptureRenderer
globals.role: pointer used by CaptureRenderer_Submit and the second request path 0x1470F0EB4

globals.name: ListenerHub
globals.role: object whose vfunc +0x38 registers the controller's two listeners (+0xC0, +0xF8) at Start

globals.name: CaptureSettings
globals.role: settings singleton (lazy via 0x1405A4FCC); byte +0x1F6 must be non-zero or Start does nothing
